homePage.description: NILO is a structured process model for programming language development, created to support students of Systems Analysis and Development (TADS). Through an iterative approach, the project enables the documentation, implementation, and validation of languages designed to solve problems across various domains.
homePage.card-nilo-subtitle: Explore all steps of the NILO process model.
homePage.card-nilo-classroom-subtitle: Access the classroom environment to view all classes and materials.

versionsPage.title: NILO process model versions
versionsPage.description: Select a version to preview the PDF, review the changes, and download the visible file.
versionsPage.changelog-subtitle: Main improvements and corrections applied in each version.

versionsPage.version-1-change-2: Detailed visual explanation of the 'input' concept in Figure 01.
versionsPage.version-1-change-3: Added theoretical explanation regarding terminal symbols in grammars.
versionsPage.version-1-change-5: Visual and hierarchical reorganization of the example in Figure 10.
versionsPage.version-2-change-2: Structural table column adjustments for proper text formatting in Table 01.
versionsPage.version-2-change-3: Restructured explanation sequence (alphabet, grammar, and related concepts).
versionsPage.version-2-change-4: Updated Figure 06 to display only tokens generated by the lexical analyzer.
versionsPage.version-2-change-5: Conceptual standardization using 'process model' throughout the document.
versionsPage.version-3-change-1: Clarified the explanation regarding code lines ignored during execution.
versionsPage.version-3-change-2: Adjusted Table 09 width for better visibility of code examples.
versionsPage.version-3-change-3: Added guidance on workspace component flexibility and complexity.
versionsPage.version-3-change-4: Removed ambiguity regarding recommendations for first-time language developers.
versionsPage.version-3-change-5: Explicitly specified the exact compiler error cause in Figure 33.
versionsPage.version-4-change-1: Relocated grammar specification as an artifact of the definition phase.
versionsPage.version-4-change-3: Added a summary figure illustrating all testing phase artifacts.
versionsPage.version-4-change-4: Formally added test cases as an explicit testing phase artifact.
versionsPage.version-4-change-5: Included a defect management document example in the testing phase.

risksPage.title: Risk recurrence table
risksPage.description: Recurring risks identified in the process, with original excerpts and correction examples.

01.problem: Not all paragraphs had justified text alignment, deviating from standard ABNT formatting.
01.solution: Apply justified formatting to all paragraphs throughout the document.

02.problem: Sentence structure error due to incorrect usage of singular and plural.
02.solution: Change the word 'algoritmos' to 'algoritmo' and the word 'intermediários' to 'intermediário'.

03.problem: Due to a very concise explanation of Figure 01, the user could not understand what the label 'input' meant in the image.
03.solution: Update the image explanation to make the meaning of 'input' more explicit.

04.problem: Lack of standardization for the term 'código-fonte' (source code), which was written without a hyphen in some places.

05.problem: In Figure 04, the word 'inteiro' (integer) is misspelled.
05.solution: Fix the spelling in the original image and replace it in the process.

06.problem: The absence of the article 'a' in a paragraph hindered immediate understanding.

07.problem: Lack of explanation about what a terminal symbol is in a grammar hindered understanding.
07.solution: Add an explanation regarding terminal symbols.

08.problem: Figure 07 is incorrectly referenced as Figure 05.

09.problem: The preposition 'de' is used incorrectly in the sentence.

10.problem: Repetition of the connective 'por fim' (finally) made reading less smooth.
10.solution: Replace one instance of 'por fim' with 'portanto' (therefore).

11.problem: CST was mentioned during syntax analysis without an explanation of its meaning.

12.problem: Use of a conjunction that weakens the sentence meaning.
12.solution: Replace the conjunction with an appropriate connective.

13.problem: Figure 10 is organized in a way that does not clearly respect visual hierarchy.
13.solution: Change the example and improve hierarchy visualization.

15.problem: Using the term 'detalhada' and 'de forma detalhada' in the same sentence reduced text flow.
15.solution: Rewrite sentence to: '[...] iremos aprofundar cada uma delas com o propósito de compreender melhor.'

16.problem: In Table 01, the word 'interpretação' is poorly formatted.
16.solution: Provide more space for the 'translation methods' column to properly format the word 'interpretação'.

17.problem: Information hierarchy during grammar explanation was not clear or fluid.
17.solution: First explain what an alphabet is, then cover grammar concepts before presenting the example.

18.problem: Figure 03 does not match the text explanation, as 'return_type' is listed as a non-terminal in text.
18.solution: Update the text explanation to align with Figure 03.

19.problem: Figure 06 is organized in a way that implies tokens are generated directly from grammar.
19.solution: Show only tokens generated by the lexical analyzer.

20.problem: The citation 'Lima ( 2022)' contains an extra space before the year.

21.problem: Figure 17 contains an unnecessary smiling face icon.

22.problem: The author noted that using 'processo' (process) was inaccurate, preferring 'modelo de processo' (process model).
22.solution: Replace occurrences of 'processo' with 'modelo de processo', 'modelo', or 'NILO'.

23.problem: The word 'listar' in '[...] nome de variáveis, listar e funções' should be 'listas'.

24.problem: The term 'comentada' sounds overly informal/technical when referring specifically to programming languages.
24.solution: Rewrite to: 'Indica que aquela linha de código será ignorada durante o seu processamento.'

25.problem: Table 09 is too narrow, hindering example visibility.

26.problem: In Table 13, a participant misunderstood 'maintaining the language after delivery'.
26.solution: Rewrite to: '[...] manter a linguagem após a produção de sua versão inicial.'

27.problem: It was unclear that new components could be added to the workspace shown in Table 14.
27.solution: Explicitly state that despite the simple example in Table 14, components are flexible and can be more complex.

28.problem: The phrase 'seja o primeiro' regarding the language project was ambiguous.
28.solution: Rewrite to: '[...] recomendada caso a linguagem a ser desenvolvida seja a primeira que o utilizador esteja produzindo…'

29.problem: Explanation for Figure 26 lacks clarity and flow.
29.solution: Rewrite sentence to clarify each grammar production rule composition.

30.problem: During Table 15 explanation, Figure 15 is incorrectly referenced.
30.solution: Correct reference to Table 15 (quadro) instead of figure.

31.problem: The phrase 'maior controle no fluxo e melhor a depuração' lacks flow.
31.solution: Rewrite to: '[...] com o objetivo de possuir maior controle no fluxo e de facilitar a depuração…'.

32.problem: Figure 33 does not make explicit why code execution failed.
32.solution: Specify exact compiler error reason directly in Figure 33.

33.problem: Specifying grammar only in coding phase showed technical inconsistency with language processor standards.
33.solution: Move grammar specification as an artifact to the definition phase.

34.problem: Using 'compilador' (compiler) as the coding artifact name was not broad enough.

35.problem: Testing phase lacked a summary figure, unlike all previous phases.
35.solution: Add a summary figure presenting artifacts to be produced in testing phase.

36.problem: Producing only source code files appeared incomplete for execution validation.
36.solution: Add test cases as an explicit artifact of the testing phase.

37.problem: The name 'diagrama de arquitetura do projeto' did not accurately reflect diagram contents.
37.solution: Rename component to 'diagrama de componentes do projeto'.

38.problem: Lack of defect management document example.
38.solution: Add a defect management document example using NiloScript in the testing phase.

39.problem: Citations and section headers do not strictly follow ABNT rules.
39.solution: Capitalize only the first letter of citations and remove indentation from section headers.
